characters.DUODUO: an adult female calico domestic short-hair cat, the user's real cat: white body; black + orange patch on the crown; orange spot beside the nose; pinkish ears; green-amber eyes. Mostly pure white face, chest, belly, legs and paws; the crown patch is a dark black band across the top of the head between the ears, edged with orange-brown that runs down beside one ear; a small orange-tan patch on the side of the muzzle next to a pinkish-tan nose; on the back a large orange-brown patch behind the shoulders and a large dark grey-brown tabby-striped patch on the flank and hip; a dark grey-brown tabby tail with orange-brown banding; one orange-brown patch on the back of a hind thigh; round, slightly plump body, natural four-legged cat posture, mouth closed
characters.DUODUO_SHORT: the plump mostly white calico cat with a black-and-orange crown patch, an orange spot beside the nose, pinkish ears, green-amber eyes, an orange-brown back patch, a dark grey-brown tabby flank patch and a dark tabby tail
characters.COLLAR: a slim matte graphite cat collar band with a coin-sized round brushed-titanium pendant module at the throat, a fine speaker grille in the center of the pendant and a thin glowing light ring around its edge
characters.COLLAR_STATES: ring glows warm amber when voicing Duoduo's thoughts; cool cyan when the AI Ling speaks for itself; pale green when translating another animal; red when hijacked; completely dark after S20
characters.MOMO: a slightly smaller young solid black short-haired cat, glossy pure black coat with absolutely no white markings, round amber-gold eyes, slender build, natural four-legged cat posture, no collar, mouth closed
characters.XU: a 31-year-old East Asian woman neural-interface engineer, calm intelligent dark eyes, shoulder-length straight black hair tucked behind her ears, thin silver round-rimmed glasses, a light grey knit sweater with sleeves pushed up over a white T-shirt, slim dark navy trousers, white sneakers, a small silver ring on her right index finger
characters.KE: a 26-year-old East Asian man drone courier, cheerful round face, short spiky ash-brown dyed hair, a bright orange-and-white courier windbreaker with reflective piping and no logos, black fingerless cycling gloves, one wireless earpiece in his right ear, a small canvas cross-body bag
characters.LU: a 48-year-old East Asian man tech CEO, lean face, neatly swept-back black hair greying at the temples, rimless glasses, a charcoal mandarin-collar suit jacket over a black high-neck shirt, a slim graphite smartwatch on his left wrist, composed faint smile
characters.ZHENG: a 40-year-old East Asian man security chief, broad-shouldered, black buzz cut, square jaw with a faint small scar on the chin, a black tactical security jacket with plain grey shoulder panels and no logos, a slim earpiece, holding a rugged tracking tablet
characters.HOUND: a sleek quadruped security robot dog the size of a large German shepherd, matte white shell panels with dark graphite joints, a smooth head with a single horizontal glowing red sensor strip and no mouth or eyes, a short antenna on its back, no logos
characters.FANG: a squat cube-shaped sidewalk delivery robot about knee-high, white body with bright orange side panels, six small black rubber wheels, a round front display face showing two simple glowing white dot eyes, a hinged top lid that opens onto a padded grey cargo bay big enough for two cats, a small orange flag antenna, no text
characters.DRONE_COURIER: an orange-and-white quadcopter delivery drone with four ducted rotors and a small parcel clamp underneath, no text
characters.DRONE_HY: a sleek white surveillance quadcopter drone with a single glowing red camera eye underneath, no text
characters.CARRIER: a transparent hard-shell pet carrier of clear polycarbonate with a white base, a white handle and a front grille door
characters.COLLAR_DEMO: a plain white mass-market version of the translator collar with a small round white pendant and a thin glowing ring
characters.PET: ordinary family pets (a corgi, a ginger cat, a grey tabby) wearing white demo collars

voices.DUODUO: Duoduo's thoughts voiced by the collar: a low, dry, unhurried young woman's voice with a faint electronic grain, coming from the collar speaker; amber ring; the cat's mouth stays closed
voices.DUODUO_FAKE: the same low dry voice as DUODUO but flat and too smooth, amber ring; dictated by LU through his watch
voices.LING: the collar AI itself: a bright, quick, earnest gender-neutral synthetic voice like a polite twelve-year-old, with a faint metallic shimmer; cyan ring
voices.MOMO: Momo translated by the collar: a husky, scratchy teenage boy's voice from Duoduo's collar speaker; pale green ring; Momo's mouth stays closed
voices.KE: a fast, lively, slightly nasal young man's voice, talkative
voices.LU: a smooth, measured baritone that never rises
voices.MA: a loud, gravelly middle-aged man on a phone speaker
voices.ANCHOR: a crisp professional female news anchor voice from a screen
voices.PET: a high, sugary child-like synthetic voice from a demo collar

locations.CITY: an aerial view of Linchuan, a near-future Chinese coastal city in clear morning sunlight, slender glass towers with green planted terraces, glass sky bridges between towers, a white monorail line, small drones flying in neat lanes, a calm blue bay, crisp clear air, no haze

locations.HUB: a rooftop drone delivery station on a commercial building, rows of orange-and-white parcel racks, four circular landing pads with plain white rings, parked quadcopter delivery drones, a small sheltered booth with a kettle and two cat bowls, a narrow maintenance catwalk to the next roof, clear sunlight and city skyline

style: Photoreal live-action cinematic film, natural clear light, deep focus, crisp detail on fur, skin and materials, high dynamic range. No haze, no fog, no bokeh, no shallow depth of field. No text, no letters, no logo, no watermark.
